headline: Warden Posts Dwindle in Linn Mercy as Carnage Mounts
war_summary: Linn Mercy remains the war's cruelest ledger. Since the last edition the Warden hold there has thinned to a single post against nine Colonial, one more ground reduced to no-man's-land, while the day's toll climbed past 8,300 Colonial and 14,800 Warden; Outwich Ranch was again the busiest ground, with actions logged within the hour of filing. Palantine Berm boils alongside — twenty-two actions in the day, the latest shortly after midnight, and hundreds falling on each side in the past two hours, five posts Colonial to two Warden. The Weathered Expanse has raised no flag in nearly seven hours, yet nearly 1,800 casualties apiece in the last two hours alone lift the day's count beyond 10,600 Colonial and 12,400 Warden; seven Warden posts stand, two in ruin. Mooring County, silent at the last report, has stirred again with fresh actions inside the past two hours, though its twelve posts remain Warden. The Nevish Line holds at seven posts to one under heavy loss, and Checkpoint Bua in Marban Hollow logged further fighting before midnight. Day 586 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
